title: TaskControl
description: Targets an existing task on behalf of its requester (contract.TaskControl), POST /v1/tasks/{ref}/steer|stop|continue. An empty task_ref is filled from the path; a non-empty one must equal it.

text.description: The correction (steer) or the continuation prompt (continue).

expected_revision.description: When positive, the task revision the requester decided on (the read_ref of continue and stop). The Task Manager first answers a known idempotency_key with its stored receipt, then rejects another revision with stale_revision before any effect.
